claim: Respondents determined by the commission in G. L. c. 151B § 5 proceedings to have committed discriminatory acts in employment are entitled to both administrative review under G. L. c. 30A and a State constitutional right to a jury trial, with the court affirming rather than overruling the contrary holding in Lavelle.
initial_reasoning: 441 Mass. 549 is the Lavelle decision, which held that respondents in G. L. c. 151B §5 are not entitled to a jury trial and that administrative review is the sole remedy. The claim asserts the opposite—affirming a jury trial right—so the citation contradicts the claim.
